CS.Title: Complete Spellbook
CS.NoEntries: Add a spellcasting entry on the PF2e character sheet first.
CS.SortHint: Use Default view to drag spells or rearrange entries. Casting type groups prepared, spontaneous, innate, and focus spells.
CS.SelectAll: Select all available spells matching these filters, across all pages
CS.SelectionHelp: Select is for importing Available spells. Added and Prepared spells are already on this character. Choose one spellcasting entry to select spells.
CS.NoDescription: No description is available. Click to open the spell details.
CS.SaveOverWarning: Replace the saved assignments with current approved preparation for
CS.DeletePresetHelp: Only this saved preset will be removed. Current preparation stays unchanged.
CS.CompareHelp: Show differences against current preparation or another preset without changing slots.
CS.Name: Name
CS.NoPrevious: No previous preparation was saved for this entry.
CS.NothingToImport: No missing eligible spells were selected.
CS.ImportWarning: missing spells will be imported into this entry. Existing spells will not be overwritten. Cancel to keep the actor unchanged.
CS.Unavailable: This spell is no longer available.
CS.PreparationWarning: Preparing an available spell adds only that spell. Replacing a slot keeps its current expended state. Follow your table's daily preparation rules.
CS.PresetWarning: Compare every replacement below. Current expended states are preserved. Do not cast or edit this entry from another client while applying.

virtual.Name: Show available spells
virtual.Hint: Find spells your character can use without adding them first. Supported class spell lists are recognized automatically.

autoSync.Name: Automatically import missing eligible spells
autoSync.Hint: Off by default. The active elected GM imports missing spells after relevant character changes for approved full-tradition entries. Never deletes spells.

legacy.Name: Include legacy spells
legacy.Hint: Include spells explicitly marked as not remastered in the virtual catalog. Existing actor spells remain visible.

uncommon.Name: Permit uncommon tradition spells
uncommon.Hint: GM campaign authorization for uncommon spells in approved full-tradition entries.

rare.Name: Permit rare tradition spells
rare.Hint: GM campaign authorization for rare spells in approved full-tradition entries.

presets.Name: Enable preparation presets
presets.Hint: Save prepared spell sets for each character. Loading a set does not restore used slots.

favorites.Name: Enable favorites
favorites.Hint: Store favorite spells on each character.

import.Name: Enable spell imports
import.Hint: Allow players to add available spells to their characters. Preparing an available spell adds it first.

sources.Name: Allowed spell compendiums
sources.Hint: Comma-separated pack IDs. Defaults to pf2e.spells-srd. Normal Foundry pack permissions also apply.

cacheMinutes.Name: Index cache duration
cacheMinutes.Hint: Cache searchable metadata. Full documents load only for details or imports. Refresh sources clears the cache.

debug.Name: Debug logging
debug.Hint: Log module action errors to the browser console.

defaultRarity.Name: Default rarity filter
defaultRarity.Hint: Display preference only. Cannot expand GM-approved access.

CS.KnownChoice: Only spells already on this character
CS.GMOnly: Only the GM can change spell access.
CS.NativeNotice: Use your character sheet to cast spells and manage focus spells, spontaneous spells, or flexible spell preparation.
CS.NoSlots: No suitable slot is ready here. Use the character sheet, or ask the GM to review Spellbook settings.
CS.Ready: This spell list was recognized automatically. You can use it without setup.
CS.AccessHelp: Use the full list only for ordinary Cleric, Druid, or Animist spells. Wizards, Witches, and Magi use spells they have learned.
CS.SpellAccess: Which spells belong in this list?
CS.NeedsReview: The GM can review this in Spellbook settings. Unchecked ranks stay on the character sheet.
CS.UnclearEntry: This character has a spell list we cannot identify safely. The GM can choose which spells and ranks belong here.
CS.SpecialEntry: These spells have special rules. Manage them on the character sheet.
CS.KnownAccess: Browse the spells already on your character
CS.SpecialRanks: Some slots may be reserved for font, school, or other special spells. The GM only needs to check the uncertain ranks. School restrictions can include cantrips.
CS.RankHelp: Check a rank only if every slot can hold an ordinary spell. Leave it unchecked if any slot is reserved for font, school, or other special spells. You can still manage those slots on the character sheet.
CS.SetupConfirmed: This spell list is ready. Change these settings only if its spell access or special slots need an adjustment.
